translations.word: Order| In relation to an order from a client: 1" an order to a Capital Market Institution from a client to execute a transaction as agent; or 2" any other order to a Capital Market Institution from a client to execute a transaction in circumstances giving rise to similar duties as those arising from an order to execute a transaction as agent. "order" shall include any decision by a Capital Market Institution to execute a transaction in exercise of discretion for a client, an investment fund that it manages or for the purpose of aggregating orders for its clients in accordance with the Market Conduct Regulations. The definition of order shall not include any requests for purchasing a new securities issue.
